description: Full gold for spring-demo, extracted from the former inline source markers. gold.csv (one row per expected taint finding: rule,file,line of the sink) is what SABER scores via agent-score-report convert:benchmark-truth; this file additionally keeps each expected trace (Step n of trace id <package>/<m>), both rule ids per finding (OpenGrep java-basic-* and JvmTaintAnalysis taint.*), and the explanatory notes (SOURCE / SECURITY SINK / CONTROL / ...), each anchored to the code line it described. CONTROL and SAFE RESPONSE notes mark the intended negative cases. Line numbers refer to the commit in hash.txt.
